headline: Regulatory overhang to weigh but long-term prospects firm

highlights: EBITDA grew 8% YoY to ~₹ 133 crore, and EBITDA margins de-grew 84 bps YoY at 18.2%.
The South cluster continued to lead growth, while North Bangalore is expected to achieve monthly EBITDA break-even by Q4FY27 and Gujarat to return to mid-teens growth.

Rising cancer incidence and improving diagnosis present structural growth opportunities, while KKR’s proposed acquisition of a 54% stake is positive given its healthcare investment pedigree and long-term investment horizon.

The oncology drug trade-margin cap remains a near-term headwind, with management expecting a mid-to-high-single-digit annualised impact on absolute EBITDA from November 2026, though the impact on FY27 will be proportionately lower and recovery is expected from FY28 onwards.
valuation: x ICICI Securities – Retail Equity Research Healthcare Global Enterprises (HEAGLO) CMP: ₹595 Target ₹ 705 (18%) Target Period: 12 months November 9, 2026 Regulatory overhang to weigh but long-term prospects firm… About the stock : HCG operates one of the largest private cancer care networks in India with end-to-end solutions available under a single corporate entity.
Rating and Target Price : Our target price is ₹ 705 based on 20 x FY28E EBITDA of ₹ 603.8 crore.

Management reiterated its target of monthly EBITDA breakeven by Q4FY27. • Trade margin cap on non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs: Management estimates an annualized mid- to high-single-digit EBITDA impact.
watch: The oncology drug trade-margin cap remains a near-term headwind, with management expecting a mid-to-high-single-digit annualised impact on absolute EBITDA from November 2026, though the impact on FY27 will be proportionately lower and recovery is expected from FY28 onwards.
We continue to monitor ARPP and cluster-wise volume growth, while expecting ROCE at newer centres to improve with ramp-up.
